description: cfd_2d_6dof_fish_x198_sym with the gait control (X 199): from t = 0.02 s the frequency goes to 1.5 Hz, the amplitude factor to 0.8 and the curvature bias to 1 (the curvature 1/L added to the angle of the midline, the lateral position from the angle), each with the critically damped dynamics of settling time 0.05 s; the phase is 2 pi int f, closed form between the target times; the inverse map of the bent body starts from the nearest station of the deformed midline. The fish log gets the columns f, a, b.
covers: sixdof_deform::midline with the gait and the curvature bias
